title: Inner-product-space isomorphisms and unitary operators
objectives: Characterize isomorphisms of inner product spaces
Relate unitary operators to adjoints and unitary matrices
Factor an invertible matrix into triangular and unitary factors
Derive the necessary conditions for an orthonormal eigenbasis
source_scope: The captions of the four recordings (positions 52, 53, 55 and 54) were read in full. The weighted function-space example, matrix cases and the three-dimensional factorization family come from them; the running matrix, shift example, Schur consequence, laboratory and exercises are original.
